content: Otpusknye (vacation pay) per TK RF st.139 + Postanovlenie 922: average daily earnings = sum of earnings over preceding 12 calendar months / 12 / 29.3, with exclusions for periods of paid leave already at average earnings, sick leave, simple/downtime, unpaid leave, strikes-affected non-work. Incomplete months prorated via 29.3/days_in_month*actual_days. Salary increases during/after period require indexation coefficient applied to earlier months. Rounding of tax: NK RF st.52 — round to whole ruble, <50 kopecks dropped, >=50 kopecks rounds up.
